verses.sloka: भृशम् आव्रजमानस्य तस्य अधो वाम लोचनम् ।प्रास्फुरत् च अस्खलत् रामो वेपथुः च अस्य जायते ॥३-६०-१॥
verses.transliteration: bhṛśam āvrajamānasya tasya adho vāma locanam ।prāsphurat ca askhalat rāmo vepathuḥ ca asya jāyate ॥3-60-1॥

translations.english: As Rama was returning( to the hermitage), his left eye throbbed repeatedly and he stumbled and his body trembled.

verses.sloka: उपालक्ष्य निमित्तानि सो अशुभानि मुहुर् मुहुः ।अपि क्षेमम् तु सीताया इति वै व्याजहार ह ॥३-६०-२॥
verses.transliteration: upālakṣya nimittāni so aśubhāni muhur muhuḥ ।api kṣemam tu sītāyā iti vai vyājahāra ha ॥3-60-2॥

translations.english: As inauspicious omens appeared again and again, doubting if all is well with Sita, he said to himself, Can Sita be safe?
translations.hindi: श्रनिष्टिताशः श्रनिध्पन्ना्ः सन्‌ | ( मो० ) स्त्र खोजने पर भी सीता को न देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी लक्ष्मण की दोनों सुन्दर भुजाओं को पकडू, उच्चस्वर से बोले

verses.sloka: त्वरमाणो जगाम अथ सीता दर्शन लालसः ।शून्यम् आवसथम् दृष्ट्वा बभूव उद्विग्न मानसः ॥३-६०-३॥
verses.transliteration: tvaramāṇo jagāma atha sītā darśana lālasaḥ ।śūnyam āvasatham dṛṣṭvā babhūva udvigna mānasaḥ ॥3-60-3॥

translations.english: Anxious to see Sita, he hastened to the hermitage and finding it empty, became restless.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! सीता कहाँ है ! वह यहाँ से कहाँ गई ? अथवा यहाँ से उसे कोई पकड़ कर ले गया ? अथवा किसी ने उसे खा डाला ?

verses.sloka: उद् भ्रमन् इव वेगेन विक्षिपन् रघु नन्दनः ।तत्र तत्र उटज स्थानम् अभिवीक्ष्य समंततः ॥३-६०-४॥
verses.transliteration: ud bhraman iva vegena vikṣipan raghu nandanaḥ ।tatra tatra uṭaja sthānam abhivīkṣya samaṁtataḥ ॥3-60-4॥

translations.english: Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, hurtled in, turning round, throwing his hands to and fro, casting his looks all around the cottage where she used to move. The cottage, devoid of Sita looked like a lotuspond, the beauty of its lotuses destroyed by winter.
translations.hindi: हे सीते ! वृक्ष की ओट में छिप यदि तुम मुझसे हँसी करती हो, तो अब और अधिक हँसी कर मुझे दुःखी मत करो

verses.sloka: ददर्श पर्ण शालाम् च सीतया रहिताम् तदा ।श्रिया विरहिताम् ध्वस्ताम् हेमन्ते पद्मिनीम् इव ॥३-६०-५॥
verses.transliteration: dadarśa parṇa śālām ca sītayā rahitām tadā ।śriyā virahitām dhvastām hemante padminīm iva ॥3-60-5॥

translations.english: Rama, the delight of the Raghu dynasty, hurtled in, turning round, throwing his hands to and fro, casting his looks all around the cottage where she used to move. The cottage, devoid of Sita looked like a lotuspond, the beauty of its lotuses destroyed by winter.
translations.hindi: हे सीते ! तुम जिन पालतू मृगछौनों के नो के साथ खेला करती थीं वे सब के सब तुम्हारे वियोग में आंसू बहते, तुम्हें स्मरण क रहे हैं

verses.sloka: रुदन्तम् इव वृक्षैः च ग्लान पुष्प मृग द्विजम् ।श्रिया विहीनम् विध्वस्तम् संत्यक्त वन दैवतैः ॥३-६०-६॥
verses.transliteration: rudantam iva vṛkṣaiḥ ca glāna puṣpa mṛga dvijam ।śriyā vihīnam vidhvastam saṁtyakta vana daivataiḥ ॥3-60-6॥

translations.english: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left. The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn here and there, the grass cushions and straw mats lay scattered. Seeing his cottage so desolate Rama wept again and again.

verses.sloka: विप्रकीर्ण अजिन कुशम् विप्रविद्ध बृसी कटम् ।दृष्ट्वा शून्य उटज स्थानम् विललाप पुनः पुनः ॥३-६०-७॥
verses.transliteration: viprakīrṇa ajina kuśam vipraviddha bṛsī kaṭam ।dṛṣṭvā śūnya uṭaja sthānam vilalāpa punaḥ punaḥ ॥3-60-7॥

translations.english: The trees with flowers withered, the animals and birds turned pale looked as if they were weeping. Bereft of their beauty they wore a ruinous look. The sylvan deities had left. The deerskin and kusa grass were strewn here and there, the grass cushions and straw mats lay scattered. Seeing his cottage so desolate Rama wept again and again.
translations.hindi: सीतया ह वे न हि जीवामि लक्ष्मण । अन्त शोकेन महता सीताहरणाजेन हे लक्ष्मण ! सीता के बिना में जी ह जाता नहीं रह मी के हर जाने से उत्पन्न हुए महाशोक ने मुझे घेर लिभ है. | द परलोके महाराजो नूनं द्रक्ष्यति मे पिता । ___ कयं प्रतिझां संशुत्य मया स्वमभियो जित;

verses.sloka: हृता मृता वा नष्टा वा भक्षिता वा भविष्यति ।निलीना अपि अथवा भीरुः अथवा वनम् आश्रिता ॥३-६०-८॥
verses.transliteration: hṛtā mṛtā vā naṣṭā vā bhakṣitā vā bhaviṣyati ।nilīnā api athavā bhīruḥ athavā vanam āśritā ॥3-60-8॥

translations.english: 'Timid Sita might have been abducted or dead or crushed or eaten up by demons. Or, she may be hiding for protection in the forest'

verses.sloka: गता विचेतुम् पुष्पाणि फलानि अपि च वा पुनः ।अथवा पद्मिनीम् याता जल अर्थम् वा नदीम् गता ॥३-६०-९॥
verses.transliteration: gatā vicetum puṣpāṇi phalāni api ca vā punaḥ ।athavā padminīm yātā jala artham vā nadīm gatā ॥3-60-9॥

translations.english: 'Maybe she has gone to pluck flowers or fruits. Or to the lotuspond or river to fetch water.'

verses.sloka: यत्नात् मृगयमाणः तु न आससाद वने प्रियाम् ।शोक रक्त ईक्षणः श्रीमान् उन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते ॥३-६०-१०॥
verses.transliteration: yatnāt mṛgayamāṇaḥ tu na āsasāda vane priyām ।śoka rakta īkṣaṇaḥ śrīmān unmatta iva lakṣyate ॥3-60-10॥

translations.english: He ransacked the forest, yet did not find his beloved. He appeared like a mad man, his eyes turned red with tears of sorrow.

verses.sloka: वृक्षात् वृक्षम् प्रधावन् स गिरीम् च अपि नदी नदम् ।बभ्राम विलपन् रामः शोक पंक अर्णव प्लुतः ॥३-६०-११॥
verses.transliteration: vṛkṣāt vṛkṣam pradhāvan sa girīm ca api nadī nadam ।babhrāma vilapan rāmaḥ śoka paṁka arṇava plutaḥ ॥3-60-11॥

translations.english: Running from tree to tree, hill to hill, and river to river and weeping, Rama was immersed in a sea of sorrow.
translations.hindi: ॥ के त्वया विरहितश्चाहं भोक्ष्ये जीवितमात्मनः । ७ है ° इताव बिलपन्‌ रामः स!तादशनलालसः

verses.sloka: अस्ति कच्चित् त्वया दृष्टा सा कदम्ब प्रिया प्रिया ।कदम्ब यदि जानीषे शंस सीताम् शुभ आननाम् ॥३-६०-१२॥
verses.transliteration: asti kaccit tvayā dṛṣṭā sā kadamba priyā priyā ।kadamba yadi jānīṣe śaṁsa sītām śubha ānanām ॥3-60-12॥

translations.english: O Kadamba tree, tell me if you have seen my beloved with a fair face and with love for kadamba flowers.

verses.sloka: स्निग्ध पल्लव संकाशाम् पीत कौशेय वासिनीम् ।शंसस्व यदि सा दृष्टा बिल्व बिल्व उपम स्तनी ॥३-६०-१३॥
verses.transliteration: snigdha pallava saṁkāśām pīta kauśeya vāsinīm ।śaṁsasva yadi sā dṛṣṭā bilva bilva upama stanī ॥3-60-13॥

translations.english: O Bilva tree, tell me if you have seen a lady delicate like your tender leaf, dressed in yellow silk, a lady whose breasts are round like Bilva fruits.
translations.hindi: कीचड़ में फॅसे हुए हाथी की तरह, शोक में मग्न हो गए। तब लक्ष्मण जी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की हितकामना से प्रेरित हो उनसे बोले

verses.sloka: अथवा अर्जुन शंस त्वम् प्रियाम् ताम् अर्जुन प्रियाम् ।जनकस्य सुता तन्वी यदि जीवति वा न वा ॥३-६०-१४॥
verses.transliteration: athavā arjuna śaṁsa tvam priyām tām arjuna priyām ।janakasya sutā tanvī yadi jīvati vā na vā ॥3-60-14॥

translations.english: O Arjuna tree, tell me if you know a timid lady, daughter of Janaka and my beloved, fond of Arjuna tree. Is the living or not ?
translations.hindi: हे बड़ी भुजाओं वाले ! आप दुःखी न हूजिये। आइये मेरे साथ सीता को ढूदने का प्रयत्न कीजिये। हे बीर! इस बन में बहुत सी कंद्राए' ( गुफाएँ ) हैं

verses.sloka: ककुभः ककुभ ऊरुम् ताम् व्यक्तम् जानाति मैथिलीम् ।लता पल्लव पुष्प आढ्यो भाति हि एष वनस्पतिः ॥३-६०-१५॥
verses.transliteration: kakubhaḥ kakubha ūrum tām vyaktam jānāti maithilīm ।latā pallava puṣpa āḍhyo bhāti hi eṣa vanaspatiḥ ॥3-60-15॥

translations.english: This Kakubha tree rich with tender leaves and flowers (perhaps)knows Maithili whose thighs are beautiful like the trunk of the Kakubha tree.

verses.sloka: भ्रमरैर् उपगीतः च यथा द्रुम वरो हि असि ।एष व्यक्तम् विजानाति तिलकः तिलक प्रियाम् ॥३-६०-१६॥
verses.transliteration: bhramarair upagītaḥ ca yathā druma varo hi asi ।eṣa vyaktam vijānāti tilakaḥ tilaka priyām ॥3-60-16॥

translations.english: This great Tilaka tree round which bees bumble surely knows the lady who loves to put tilaka marks on the forehead.
translations.hindi: हे काकुत्स्थ ! यदि आप मेरा कहना मानें तो शोकाकुल मत हजिए । इस प्रकार जव लक्ष्मण जी ने सोहाद्रे से समझाया तब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी का चित्त ठिकाने हुआ और

verses.sloka: अशोक शोक अपनुद शोक उपहत चेतनम् ।त्वन् नामानम् कुरु क्षिप्रम् प्रिया संदर्शनेन माम् ॥३-६०-१७॥
verses.transliteration: aśoka śoka apanuda śoka upahata cetanam ।tvan nāmānam kuru kṣipram priyā saṁdarśanena mām ॥3-60-17॥

translations.english: O Ashoka tree, dispeller of sorrow, by quickly showing me my darling make me ashoka (free from sorrow) as I am griefstricken at heart.
translations.hindi: हो ह है जिया और बल पक्षियों से सेवित नदी स्नान करने ग अथवा हम दोनो के हुँ को नही छिपी क साथ हँसी करने को १ वञ्जुलो बेतसः । (गो० ) एकषष्टितमः सगः ४७७ वित्रासयितुकामा वा लीना स्यात्कानने क्वचित्‌ । जिज्ञासमाना? वैदेहीं खां मां च पुरुषषभ

verses.sloka: यदि ताल त्वया दृष्टा पक्व ताल फल स्तनी ।कथयस्व वरारोहाम् कारुण्यम् यदि ते मयि ॥३-६०-१८॥
verses.transliteration: yadi tāla tvayā dṛṣṭā pakva tāla phala stanī ।kathayasva varārohām kāruṇyam yadi te mayi ॥3-60-18॥

translations.english: O Palmyra tree be kind to me and tell me if you have seen my beautiful beloved who has breasts like ripe palmyra fruit?
translations.hindi: अतएव हे श्रीमन्‌ ! हम दोनों को उनके खोजने में शीघ्र यत्नवान्‌ होना चाहिए । जहाँ हो बहाँ जानकी को पाने के लिए हमको यह सारा बन मभाना चाहिए

verses.sloka: यदि दृष्टा त्वया सीता जम्बो जांबूनद सम प्रभा ।प्रियाम् यदि विजानासि निःशंक कथयस्व मे ॥३-६०-१९॥
verses.transliteration: yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā sītā jambo jāṁbūnada sama prabhā ।priyām yadi vijānāsi niḥśaṁka kathayasva me ॥3-60-19॥

translations.english: O Jambu tree, do not hesitate to tell me if you know Sita whose body shines lovely like gold.

verses.sloka: अहो त्वम् कर्णिकार अद्य पुष्पितः शोभसे भृशम् ।कर्णिकार प्रियाम् साध्वीम् शंस दृष्टा यदि प्रिया ॥३-६०-२०॥
verses.transliteration: aho tvam karṇikāra adya puṣpitaḥ śobhase bhṛśam ।karṇikāra priyām sādhvīm śaṁsa dṛṣṭā yadi priyā ॥3-60-20॥

translations.english: O Karnikara tree with flowers in full bloom, tell me if you have seen my faithful beloved who is fond of karnikara flowers.

verses.sloka: चूत नीप महा सालान् पनसान् कुरवान् धवान् ।दाडिमान् अपि तान् गत्वा दृष्ट्वा रामो महायशाः ॥३-६०-२१॥
verses.transliteration: cūta nīpa mahā sālān panasān kuravān dhavān ।dāḍimān api tān gatvā dṛṣṭvā rāmo mahāyaśāḥ ॥3-60-21॥

translations.english: Renowned Rama, like a madman confused, approached the Mango, Kadamba , Sal and Jackfruit, Dhava, Champak, Ketaki trees and Pomegranate, Jasmine and Madhavi creepers, in order to make similar queries.

verses.sloka: बकुलान् अथ पुन्नागान् च चंदनान्केतकान् तथा ।पृच्छन् रामो वने भ्रान्त उन्मत्त इव लक्ष्यते ॥३-६०-२२॥
verses.transliteration: bakulān atha punnāgān ca caṁdanānketakān tathā ।pṛcchan rāmo vane bhrānta unmatta iva lakṣyate ॥3-60-22॥

translations.english: Renowned Rama, like a madman confused, approached the Mango, Kadamba , Sal and Jackfruit, Dhava, Champak, Ketaki trees and Pomegranate, Jasmine and Madhavi creepers, in order to make similar queries.

verses.sloka: अथवा मृग शाब अक्षीम् मृग जानासि मैथिलीम् ।मृग विप्रेक्षणी कांता मृगीभिः सहिता भवेत् ॥३-६०-२३॥
verses.transliteration: athavā mṛga śāba akṣīm mṛga jānāsi maithilīm ।mṛga viprekṣaṇī kāṁtā mṛgībhiḥ sahitā bhavet ॥3-60-23॥

translations.english: Or, O deer do you know about Maithili who has the eyes of a fawn? My beloved who has the restless eyes of a doe may be found in their company.
translations.hindi: ड 'ता नहीं दिख तब दुःख से रूतप्त लक्ष्मण, दर्डकबन में म कयी वतला बोले-दे महाप्राज्ञ ! तुम्हें जानकी जी वैसे ही लेगी जै बलि को बांध, विष्णु को यह पृथिवी मिली थी। इस ।प्रकार सोहाड से लक्ष्मण जी ने श्रीरामजन्द्र जो से कहा

verses.sloka: गज सा गज नासोरुः यदि दृष्टा त्वया भवेत् ।ताम् मन्ये विदिताम् तुभ्यम् आख्याहि वर वारण ॥३-६०-२४॥
verses.transliteration: gaja sā gaja nāsoruḥ yadi dṛṣṭā tvayā bhavet ।tām manye viditām tubhyam ākhyāhi vara vāraṇa ॥3-60-24॥

translations.english: O elephant tell me if you have seen her whose thighs are like the trunk of an elephant. O best of elephants, tell me if you know her.

verses.sloka: शार्दूल यदि सा दृष्टा प्रिया चंद्र निभ आनना ।मैथिली मम विस्रब्धम् कथयस्व न ते भयम् ॥३-६०-२५॥
verses.transliteration: śārdūla yadi sā dṛṣṭā priyā caṁdra nibha ānanā ।maithilī mama visrabdham kathayasva na te bhayam ॥3-60-25॥

translations.english: O tiger tell me freely and fearlessly if you have seen my beloved princess from Mithila with a face like the moon.

verses.sloka: किम् धावसि प्रिये नूनम् दृष्टा असि कमल ईक्षणे ।वृक्षेण आच्चाद्य च आत्मानम् किम् माम् न प्रतिभाषसे ॥३-६०-२६॥
verses.transliteration: kim dhāvasi priye nūnam dṛṣṭā asi kamala īkṣaṇe ।vṛkṣeṇa āccādya ca ātmānam kim mām na pratibhāṣase ॥3-60-26॥

translations.english: O lotus eyed darling, why are you running away? I have already seen you. Why are you hiding behind trees and not replying to me?
translations.hindi: गिरिश्वायं महाप्राज्ञ वहुकंदरनिकरः । न हि पश्यामि बेदेही प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसीम ।!२७॥ तब दुःख से विकल हो श्रीरामचन्द्र जी दीन वाणी से लक्ष्मण से कहने लगे। हे महाप्राज्ञ ! मैंने समस्त वन और खिले हुए कमलो से युक्त सरोवरें, यह पहाड़, बहुत सी कंदराए' और अनेक झरने भली भाँति खोजे, किन्तु प्राणों से भी बढ़ कर वैदेही न मिली

verses.sloka: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ वरारोहे न ते अस्ति करुणा मयि ।न अत्यर्थम् हास्य शीला असि किम् अर्थम् माम् उपेक्षसे ॥३-६०-२७॥
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha varārohe na te asti karuṇā mayi ।na atyartham hāsya śīlā asi kim artham mām upekṣase ॥3-60-27॥

translations.english: O my beautiful beloved, stay, stay Have you no compassion for me ? You are so fond of fun. Why do you avoid me?

verses.sloka: पीत कौशेयकेन असि सूचिता वर वर्णिनि ।धावन्ति अपि मया दृष्टा तिष्ठ यदि अस्ति सौहृदम् ॥३-६०-२८॥
verses.transliteration: pīta kauśeyakena asi sūcitā vara varṇini ।dhāvanti api mayā dṛṣṭā tiṣṭha yadi asti sauhṛdam ॥3-60-28॥

translations.english: O lady of lovely complexion, I can see your yellow silk (flying), while you are running away. If you have love for me, stay on.
translations.hindi: सीता-हरण से व्यथित श्रीरामचन्द्र इस प्रकार विलाप करते हुए उदास ओर शोकाकुल हो दो घड़ी के लिए परवश हो गए

verses.sloka: न एव सा नूनम् अथवा हिंसिता चारु हासिनी ।कृच्छ्रम् प्राप्तम् न माम् नूनम् यथा उपेक्षितुम् अर्हति ॥३-६०-२९॥
verses.transliteration: na eva sā nūnam athavā hiṁsitā cāru hāsinī ।kṛcchram prāptam na mām nūnam yathā upekṣitum arhati ॥3-60-29॥

translations.english: O lady with a sweet smile I have never hurt you. When I am in difficulty it does not behove you to ignore me.

verses.sloka: व्यक्तम् सा भक्षिता बाला राक्षसैः पिशित अशनैः ।विभज्य अंगानि सर्वाणि मया विरहिता प्रिया ॥३-६०-३०॥
verses.transliteration: vyaktam sā bhakṣitā bālā rākṣasaiḥ piśita aśanaiḥ ।vibhajya aṁgāni sarvāṇi mayā virahitā priyā ॥3-60-30॥

translations.english: It is clear that separated from me, the body of my young beloved is torn off and eaten away by carnivorous demons.
translations.hindi: विह्दल.--परवशः ( गो० ) श्रवसन्नाङ्गः-कृशाङ्ञः | (गो ) ३ गतबुद्धि:--निस्संश: | ( शो» ) ४ विचेतन:--निश्चेष्ठ: ( गो० ) ४८० अरण्यकाण्ड राजीवलोचन श्रीरामचन्द्र बारंबार लंत्री सांसे ले और “हा 3) ग हि प्रिये” कह्‌ तथा गदूगद हो, उच्च स्वर से रोने लगे

verses.sloka: नूनम् तत् शुभ दंत ओष्ठम् सुनासम् शुभ कुण्डलम् ।पूर्ण चंद्र निभम् ग्रस्तम् मुखम् निष्प्रभताम् गतम् ॥३-६०-३१॥
verses.transliteration: nūnam tat śubha daṁta oṣṭham sunāsam śubha kuṇḍalam ।pūrṇa caṁdra nibham grastam mukham niṣprabhatām gatam ॥3-60-31॥

translations.english: Her beautiful face with her sparkling teeth and lips, wellshaped nose, shining earrings has been like the full moon, eclipsed and rendered pale.

verses.sloka: सा हि चंपक वर्ण आभा ग्रीवा ग्रैवेयक उचिता ।कोमला विलपन्त्याः तु कान्ताया भक्षिता शुभा ॥३-६०-३२॥
verses.transliteration: sā hi caṁpaka varṇa ābhā grīvā graiveyaka ucitā ।komalā vilapantyāḥ tu kāntāyā bhakṣitā śubhā ॥3-60-32॥

translations.english: That delicate, beautiful neck of my beloved having the complexion of a champak flower and adorned with necklaces was perhaps eaten up.

verses.sloka: नूनम् विक्षिप्यमाणौ तौ बाहू पल्लव कोमलौ ।भक्षितौ वेपमान अग्रौ स हस्त आभरण अंगदौ ॥३-६०-३३॥
verses.transliteration: nūnam vikṣipyamāṇau tau bāhū pallava komalau ।bhakṣitau vepamāna agrau sa hasta ābharaṇa aṁgadau ॥3-60-33॥

translations.english: Her arms, delicate like tender leaves, their tips (fingers) quivering, adorned with armlets and bracelets have surely been eaten away.

verses.sloka: मया विरहिता बाला रक्षसाम् भक्षणाय वै ।सार्थेन इव परित्यक्ता भक्षिता बहु बांधवा ॥३-६०-३४॥
verses.transliteration: mayā virahitā bālā rakṣasām bhakṣaṇāya vai ।sārthena iva parityaktā bhakṣitā bahu bāṁdhavā ॥3-60-34॥

translations.english: The young lady having many relations, forsaken by me, has been (perhaps) picked up by a demon for food and later abandoned halfeaten.

verses.sloka: हा लक्ष्मण महाबाहो पश्यसे त्वम् प्रियाम् क्वचित् ।हा प्रिये क्व गता भद्रे हा सीते इति पुनः पुनः ॥३-६०-३५॥
verses.transliteration: hā lakṣmaṇa mahābāho paśyase tvam priyām kvacit ।hā priye kva gatā bhadre hā sīte iti punaḥ punaḥ ॥3-60-35॥

translations.english: O longarmed Lakshmana, are you able to see my beloved anywhere? O noble lady, O darling, where have you gone? O Sita SIta

verses.sloka: इति एवम् विलपन् रामः परिधावन् वनात् वनम् ।क्वचित् उद् भ्रमते वेगात् क्वचित् विभ्रमते बलात् ॥३-६०-३६॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam vilapan rāmaḥ paridhāvan vanāt vanam ।kvacit ud bhramate vegāt kvacit vibhramate balāt ॥3-60-36॥

translations.english: Rama ran from forest to forest, now jumping, now taking strong strides, but all the time weeping, a madman busy in search of his beloved.

verses.sloka: क्वचित् मत्त इव आभाति कांता अन्वेषण तत्परः ।स वनानि नदीः शैलान् गिरि प्रस्रवणानि च ।काननानि च वेगेन भ्रमति अपरिसंस्थितः ॥३-६०-३७॥
verses.transliteration: kvacit matta iva ābhāti kāṁtā anveṣaṇa tatparaḥ ।sa vanāni nadīḥ śailān giri prasravaṇāni ca ।kānanāni ca vegena bhramati aparisaṁsthitaḥ ॥3-60-37॥

translations.english: He rushed through forests, rivers, hills and mountain streams and through dense jungles with an unstable mind.

verses.sloka: तदा स गत्वा विपुलम् महत् वनम्परीत्य सर्वम् तु अथ मैथिलीम् प्रति ।अनिष्ठित आशः स चकार मार्गणेपुनः प्रियायाः परमम् परिश्रमम् ॥३-६०-३८॥
verses.transliteration: tadā sa gatvā vipulam mahat vanamparītya sarvam tu atha maithilīm prati ।aniṣṭhita āśaḥ sa cakāra mārgaṇepunaḥ priyāyāḥ paramam pariśramam ॥3-60-38॥

translations.english: Rama went about the vast forest searching for the princess from Mithila all over not giving up hope of finding her. He continued to make great efforts for searching his beloved. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixtieth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
